inputBoundary: Caller-supplied nonnegative outgoing, incoming, missed, SMS-sent, and SMS-received counts from one already-selected source window.
outputBoundary: Three exact rational count pairs and their numeric quotients: outgoing/incoming, missed/(outgoing+incoming), and SMS-sent/SMS-received.
limitations: This binding does not classify call or SMS records, identify contacts, select a time window, or synthesize missing counts.
The source does not disclose zero-denominator behavior, so a zero denominator fails closed rather than producing an invented zero, infinity, or NaN.
This binding does not infer whether repeated or duplicate source records should be collapsed.
This binding does not reproduce downstream feature selection, normalization, resampling, or classification.
